description: spaCy NER baseline comparison with Legal-BERT NER

interpretation.note: spaCy pt_core_news_lg provides PER/ORG/LOC/MISC entity types. Legal-BERT provides PESSOA/ORGANIZACAO/LOCAL/TEMPO/LEGISLACAO/JURISPRUDENCIA. Comparison is limited to overlapping types (PER↔PESSOA, ORG↔ORGANIZACAO, LOC↔LOCAL). Legal-BERT's unique types (TEMPO, LEGISLACAO, JURISPRUDENCIA) represent domain-specific value that general-purpose NER cannot provide.
